name: Deseo Lúcido
source: You start having lucid dreams about your attractive neighbour, Saya. By day, your relationship slowly grows; by night, convinced it’s all just a dream, you let yourself indulge in your hottest fantasies with her and do almost anything you want… but Saya starts acting a little too real.
translation: 你开始频繁在清醒梦中梦见自己迷人的女邻居纱耶。白天，你们的关系在点滴相处中慢慢升温；到了夜晚，笃定一切不过是梦境的你肆意放纵着对她最火热的幻想，几乎为所欲为……然而，纱耶的反应却开始变得真实得有些反常。
